manifest.rationale: Unchanged 34 cases and projections. All modes share the True-invariant substitution shortcut. The two legacy-engine controls isolate this shared construction optimization from search changes. Four threshold modes share exact transition/edge caching, cross-horizon decision intervals, shortest singleton suffix policies and lazy child evaluation. These are infrastructure, not novelty claims. No reruns of external/game baselines, no random seeds or LLM calls. Doors was a development diagnostic; the unchanged suite is a paired regression study, not an independent holdout.
